name: Bőny (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bőny (a blue oval with a lion, a fleur-de-lis and a wavy stripe within a yellow frame) above the name BŐNY in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Bőny arms in a yellow frame
